::: {.callout-note}
## Build your Kaizen experiment roadmap

1. Upload `gap-analysis.csv` exported from the Gap Analysis workspace. Critical or high gaps automatically become starting experiment cards with their baseline and target.
2. Use **Board** to review experiments by status or **Table** to edit the complete roadmap.
3. Select **Edit** on a card or table row to refine its hypothesis, checklist, owner, priority, status, and success metric.
4. Check off action steps as work is completed and move each card through verification.
5. Export `kaizen-experiments.json` or `kaizen-experiments.csv`. Your browser will prompt for the download; save or move it into `output/`.
:::

```{ojs}
  {key: "sync_error_rate_pct", label: "Sync Error Rate (%)"},

viewof kaizen_experiment_workspace = {

  const kaizen_editor_controls = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_editor_controls.className = "kaizen-controls kaizen-wide";

  const kaizen_delete = kaizen_button("Delete experiment");
  const kaizen_cancel = kaizen_button("Cancel");
  kaizen_editor_controls.append(kaizen_save, kaizen_delete, kaizen_cancel);

    kaizen_title.label,
    kaizen_pipeline.label,
    kaizen_gap.label,
    kaizen_hypothesis.label,
    kaizen_steps.label,
    kaizen_owner.label,
    kaizen_success.label,
    kaizen_priority.label,
    kaizen_pdca.label,
    kaizen_status_control.label,
    kaizen_editor_controls
  );
  kaizen_editor_panel.append(kaizen_editor_heading, kaizen_editor);

  const kaizen_export_panel = document.createElement("section");
  kaizen_export_panel.className = "kaizen-panel";
  const kaizen_export_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  kaizen_export_heading.textContent = "Export Kaizen Roadmap";
  const kaizen_export_controls = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_export_controls.className = "kaizen-controls";
  const kaizen_json = kaizen_button("Export Kaizen Roadmap (JSON)");
  const kaizen_csv = kaizen_button("Export Kaizen Roadmap (CSV)");
  const kaizen_export_help = document.createElement("span");
  kaizen_export_help.textContent =
    "Your browser will download kaizen-experiments.json or kaizen-experiments.csv. Save or move the file into output/.";
  kaizen_export_controls.append(
    kaizen_json,
    kaizen_csv,
    kaizen_export_help
  );
  kaizen_export_panel.append(kaizen_export_heading, kaizen_export_controls);

  const kaizen_message = document.createElement("p");
  kaizen_message.className = "kaizen-status";
  kaizen_message.setAttribute("role", "status");
  kaizen_message.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  kaizen_root.append(
    kaizen_import_panel,
    kaizen_roadmap_panel,
    kaizen_editor_panel,
    kaizen_export_panel,
    kaizen_message
  );

  function kaizen_button(label) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = label;
    return button;
  }

  function kaizen_labeled_control(label_text, kind, options = []) {
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.textContent = label_text;
    const control = document.createElement(kind);
    if (kind === "input") control.type = "text";
    options.forEach((value) => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = value;
      option.textContent = value;
      control.append(option);
    });
    label.append(control);
    return {label, control};
  }

  function kaizen_notify(message) {
    kaizen_message.textContent = message;
  }

  function kaizen_id() {
    return globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ??
      `kaizen-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
  }

  function kaizen_parse_csv(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [];
    let field = "";
    let quoted = false;
    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const character = text[index];
      if (quoted) {
        if (character === '"' && text[index + 1] === '"') {
          field += '"';
          index += 1;
        } else if (character === '"') {
          quoted = false;
        } else {
          field += character;
        }
      } else if (character === '"') {
        quoted = true;
      } else if (character === ",") {
        row.push(field);
        field = "";
      } else if (character === "\n") {
        row.push(field);
        rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        field = "";
      } else if (character !== "\r") {
        field += character;
      }
    }
    if (quoted) throw new Error("The CSV contains an unclosed quoted value.");
    if (field || row.length) {
      row.push(field);
      rows.push(row);
    }
    if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error("The CSV has no gap records.");
    const headers = rows[0].map((header, index) =>
      (index === 0 ? header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "") : header).trim()
    );
    const gap_columns = [
      "process_node",
      "metric",
      "baseline_value",
      "target_value",
      "gap_status"
    ];
    if (gap_columns.some((header) => !headers.includes(header))) {
      throw new Error(
        `The CSV must contain ${gap_columns.join(", ")} columns.`
      );
    }
    const records = rows.slice(1)
      .filter((values) => values.some((value) => value !== ""))
      .map((values) => Object.fromEntries(
        headers.map((header, index) => [header, values[index] ?? ""])
      ));
    const prioritized_columns = [
      "priority_category",
      "impact_score",
      "effort_score"
    ];
    return {
      type: prioritized_columns.every((header) => headers.includes(header))
        ? "prioritized"
        : "gap",
      records
    };
  }

  function kaizen_from_gap(record) {
    const process_node = String(record.process_node).trim();
    const metric = String(record.metric).trim();
    const baseline = String(record.baseline_value).trim();
    const target = String(record.target_value).trim();
    const metric_label = pam_kaizen_fields.find(
      (field) => field.key === metric
    )?.label ?? metric;
    return {
      id: kaizen_id(),
      pipeline_family: "",
      title: `${process_node}: improve ${metric_label}`,
      target_gap: `${metric_label}: ${baseline} baseline → ${target} target`,
      hypothesis:
        `If we [action], then ${metric_label} will improve from ${baseline} to ${target} during [pilot period].`,
      action_steps: [],
      owner: "",
      success_metric: `${metric_label} reaches ${target}`,
      priority: "High",
      pdca_stage: "Plan",
      status: "Backlog / Proposed",
      source_gap_status: String(record.gap_status).trim()
    };
  }

  function kaizen_priority_from_category(category) {
    if (/quick win|strategic/i.test(category)) return "High";
    if (/fill-in/i.test(category)) return "Medium";
    return "Low";
  }

  function kaizen_from_prioritized(record) {
    const experiment = kaizen_from_gap(record);
    const category = String(record.priority_category).trim();
    return {
      ...experiment,
      priority: kaizen_priority_from_category(category),
      priority_category: category,
      impact_score: String(record.impact_score).trim(),
      effort_score: String(record.effort_score).trim()
    };
  }

  function kaizen_blank() {
    return {
      id: kaizen_id(),
      pipeline_family: "",
      title: "New Kaizen experiment",
      target_gap: "",
      hypothesis:
        "If we [action], then [metric] will improve from [baseline] to [target] during [pilot period].",
      action_steps: [],
      owner: "",
      success_metric: "",
      priority: "Medium",
      pdca_stage: "Plan",
      status: "Backlog / Proposed",
      source_gap_status: ""
    };
  }

  function kaizen_dispatch() {
    kaizen_root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  }

  function kaizen_select(experiment) {
    kaizen_state.selected_id = experiment.id;
    kaizen_title.control.value = experiment.title;
    kaizen_pipeline.control.value = experiment.pipeline_family;
    kaizen_gap.control.value = experiment.target_gap;
    kaizen_hypothesis.control.value = experiment.hypothesis;
    kaizen_steps.control.value =
      experiment.action_steps.map((step) => step.text).join("\n");
    kaizen_owner.control.value = experiment.owner;
    kaizen_success.control.value = experiment.success_metric;
    kaizen_priority.control.value = experiment.priority;
    kaizen_pdca.control.value = experiment.pdca_stage;
    kaizen_status_control.control.value = experiment.status;
    kaizen_editor_panel.hidden = false;
    kaizen_editor_heading.focus?.();
  }

  function kaizen_options(select, values, selected) {
    values.forEach((value) => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = value;
      option.textContent = value;
      option.selected = value === selected;
      select.append(option);
    });
  }

  function kaizen_render_card(experiment) {
    const card = document.createElement("article");
    card.className = "kaizen-card";
    card.dataset.priority = experiment.priority;
    const title = document.createElement("h4");
    title.textContent = experiment.title;
    const gap = document.createElement("p");
    const gap_label = document.createElement("strong");
    gap_label.textContent = "Target gap: ";
    gap.append(gap_label, experiment.target_gap || "Not set");
    const hypothesis = document.createElement("p");
    hypothesis.textContent = experiment.hypothesis;
    const badges = document.createElement("p");
    const priority_badge = document.createElement("span");
    priority_badge.className = "kaizen-badge kaizen-priority-badge";
    priority_badge.dataset.priority = experiment.priority;
    priority_badge.textContent = [
      `${experiment.priority} priority`,
      experiment.priority_category
    ].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    const pdca_badge = document.createElement("span");
    pdca_badge.className = "kaizen-badge kaizen-pdca-badge";
    pdca_badge.textContent = `${experiment.pdca_stage} · PDCA`;
    const status_badge = document.createElement("span");
    status_badge.className = "kaizen-badge kaizen-status-badge";
    status_badge.textContent = experiment.status;
    badges.append(priority_badge, pdca_badge, status_badge);
    const details = document.createElement("p");
    details.textContent =
      `Pipeline: ${experiment.pipeline_family || "Not set"} · Owner: ${experiment.owner || "Unassigned"}${experiment.impact_score ? ` · Impact: ${experiment.impact_score}` : ""}${experiment.effort_score ? ` · Effort: ${experiment.effort_score}` : ""}`;
    const checklist = document.createElement("div");
    checklist.className = "kaizen-checklist";
    experiment.action_steps.forEach((step) => {
      const label = document.createElement("label");
      const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
      checkbox.type = "checkbox";
      checkbox.checked = step.done;
      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
        step.done = checkbox.checked;
        kaizen_dispatch();
      });
      const text = document.createElement("span");
      text.textContent = step.text;
      label.append(checkbox, text);
      checklist.append(label);
    });
    const controls = document.createElement("div");
    controls.className = "kaizen-controls";
    const status = document.createElement("select");
    status.setAttribute("aria-label", `Status for ${experiment.title}`);
    kaizen_options(status, kaizen_statuses, experiment.status);
    status.addEventListener("change", () => {
      experiment.status = status.value;
      kaizen_render();
      kaizen_dispatch();
      kaizen_notify(`${experiment.title} moved to ${experiment.status}.`);
    });
    const edit = kaizen_button("Edit");
    edit.addEventListener("click", () => kaizen_select(experiment));
    controls.append(status, edit);
    card.append(title, badges, gap, hypothesis, details, checklist, controls);
    return card;
  }

  function kaizen_edit_control(experiment, field, kind = "input") {
    const control = document.createElement(kind);
    if (kind === "input") control.type = "text";
    control.value = field === "action_steps"
      ? experiment.action_steps.map((step) => step.text).join("; ")
      : experiment[field];
    control.setAttribute("aria-label", `${field} for ${experiment.title}`);
    control.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if (field === "action_steps") {
        const completed = new Map(
          experiment.action_steps.map((step) => [step.text, step.done])
        );
        experiment.action_steps = control.value
          .split(";")
          .map((text) => text.trim())
          .filter(Boolean)
          .map((text) => ({text, done: completed.get(text) || false}));
      } else {
        experiment[field] = control.value.trim();
      }
      kaizen_render();
      kaizen_dispatch();
    });
    return control;
  }

  function kaizen_render_board() {
    const board = document.createElement("div");
    board.className = "kaizen-board";
    kaizen_statuses.forEach((status) => {
      const column = document.createElement("section");
      column.className = "kaizen-column";
      const experiments = kaizen_state.experiments.filter(
        (experiment) => experiment.status === status
      );
      const heading = document.createElement("h3");
      heading.className = "kaizen-column-title";
      heading.textContent = `${status} (${experiments.length})`;
      column.append(heading);
      experiments.forEach((experiment) => {
        column.append(kaizen_render_card(experiment));
      });
      board.append(column);
    });
    kaizen_view.replaceChildren(board);
  }

  function kaizen_render_table() {
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "kaizen-table-wrap";
    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "kaizen-table";
    const head = document.createElement("thead");
    const head_row = document.createElement("tr");
    [
      "Title",
      "Pipeline",
      "Target gap",
      "Hypothesis",
      "Action steps",
      "Owner",
      "Success metric",
      "Priority",
      "PDCA stage",
      "Status",
      "Actions"
    ].forEach((label) => {
      const heading = document.createElement("th");
      heading.scope = "col";
      heading.textContent = label;
      head_row.append(heading);
    });
    head.append(head_row);
    const body = document.createElement("tbody");
    kaizen_state.experiments.forEach((experiment) => {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");
      [
        ["title", "input"],
        ["pipeline_family", "input"],
        ["target_gap", "input"],
        ["hypothesis", "textarea"],
        ["action_steps", "textarea"],
        ["owner", "input"],
        ["success_metric", "input"]
      ].forEach(([field, kind]) => {
        const cell = document.createElement("td");
        cell.append(kaizen_edit_control(experiment, field, kind));
        row.append(cell);
      });
      const priority_cell = document.createElement("td");
      const priority = document.createElement("select");
      kaizen_options(priority, kaizen_priorities, experiment.priority);
      priority.addEventListener("change", () => {
        experiment.priority = priority.value;
        kaizen_dispatch();
      });
      priority_cell.append(priority);
      const pdca_cell = document.createElement("td");
      const pdca = document.createElement("select");
      kaizen_options(pdca, kaizen_pdca_stages, experiment.pdca_stage);
      pdca.addEventListener("change", () => {
        experiment.pdca_stage = pdca.value;
        kaizen_dispatch();
      });
      pdca_cell.append(pdca);
      const status_cell = document.createElement("td");
      const status = document.createElement("select");
      kaizen_options(status, kaizen_statuses, experiment.status);
      status.addEventListener("change", () => {
        experiment.status = status.value;
        kaizen_dispatch();
      });
      status_cell.append(status);
      const actions = document.createElement("td");
      const edit = kaizen_button("Edit");
      edit.addEventListener("click", () => kaizen_select(experiment));
      actions.append(edit);
      row.append(priority_cell, pdca_cell, status_cell, actions);
      body.append(row);
    });
    table.append(head, body);
    wrap.append(table);
    kaizen_view.replaceChildren(wrap);
  }

  function kaizen_render() {
    kaizen_board_button.setAttribute(
      "aria-pressed",
      String(kaizen_state.view === "board")
    );
    kaizen_table_button.setAttribute(
      "aria-pressed",
      String(kaizen_state.view === "table")
    );
    if (kaizen_state.experiments.length === 0) {
      const empty = document.createElement("p");
      empty.className = "kaizen-empty";
      empty.textContent =
        "Import gap-analysis.csv or prioritized-experiments.csv, or add a blank experiment to begin.";
      kaizen_view.replaceChildren(empty);
    } else if (kaizen_state.view === "board") {
      kaizen_render_board();
    } else {
      kaizen_render_table();
    }
  }

  function kaizen_set_view(view) {
    kaizen_state.view = view;
    kaizen_render();
  }

  kaizen_board_button.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => kaizen_set_view("board")
  );
  kaizen_table_button.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => kaizen_set_view("table")
  );

  kaizen_file.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    try {
      const file = kaizen_file.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        throw new Error("Choose a gap-analysis.csv or prioritized-experiments.csv file smaller than 5 MB.");
      }
      const imported = kaizen_parse_csv(await file.text());
      const priority_records = imported.type === "prioritized"
        ? imported.records
        : imported.records.filter((record) =>
        /critical|high/i.test(String(record.gap_status))
      );
      if (priority_records.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
         imported.type === "prioritized"
           ? "No prioritized experiment records were found."
           : "No critical or high gaps were found. Review gap_status values or add an experiment manually."
        );
      }
      if (
        kaizen_state.experiments.length > 0 &&
        !globalThis.confirm(
          "Replace the current roadmap with experiments from this file?"
        )
      ) {
        kaizen_file.value = "";
        return;
      }
      kaizen_state.experiments = priority_records.map(
        imported.type === "prioritized" ? kaizen_from_prioritized : kaizen_from_gap
      );
      kaizen_state.selected_id = null;
      kaizen_editor_panel.hidden = true;
      kaizen_render();
      kaizen_dispatch();
      kaizen_notify(
        imported.type === "prioritized"
          ? `Loaded ${priority_records.length} prioritized experiment card(s).`
          : `Created ${priority_records.length} experiment card(s) from priority gaps.`
      );
    } catch (error) {
      kaizen_notify(error.message);
    }
  });

  kaizen_add.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const experiment = kaizen_blank();
    kaizen_state.experiments.push(experiment);
    kaizen_render();
    kaizen_select(experiment);
    kaizen_dispatch();
    kaizen_notify("Added a blank experiment.");
  });

  kaizen_save.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const experiment = kaizen_state.experiments.find(
      (candidate) => candidate.id === kaizen_state.selected_id
    );
    if (!experiment) return;
    const title = kaizen_title.control.value.trim();
    if (!title) {
      kaizen_notify("Enter an experiment title before saving.");
      return;
    }
    const completed = new Map(
      experiment.action_steps.map((step) => [step.text, step.done])
    );
    experiment.title = title;
    experiment.pipeline_family = kaizen_pipeline.control.value;
    experiment.target_gap = kaizen_gap.control.value.trim();
    experiment.hypothesis = kaizen_hypothesis.control.value.trim();
    experiment.action_steps = kaizen_steps.control.value
      .split("\n")
      .map((text) => text.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((text) => ({text, done: completed.get(text) || false}));
    experiment.owner = kaizen_owner.control.value.trim();
    experiment.success_metric = kaizen_success.control.value.trim();
    experiment.priority = kaizen_priority.control.value;
    experiment.pdca_stage = kaizen_pdca.control.value;
    experiment.status = kaizen_status_control.control.value;
    kaizen_editor_panel.hidden = true;
    kaizen_render();
    kaizen_dispatch();
    kaizen_notify(`Saved ${experiment.title}.`);
  });

  kaizen_delete.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const experiment = kaizen_state.experiments.find(
      (candidate) => candidate.id === kaizen_state.selected_id
    );
    if (!experiment || !globalThis.confirm(`Delete "${experiment.title}"?`)) {
      return;
    }
    kaizen_state.experiments = kaizen_state.experiments.filter(
      (candidate) => candidate.id !== experiment.id
    );
    kaizen_state.selected_id = null;
    kaizen_editor_panel.hidden = true;
    kaizen_render();
    kaizen_dispatch();
    kaizen_notify(`Deleted ${experiment.title}.`);
  });

  kaizen_cancel.addEventListener("click", () => {
    kaizen_editor_panel.hidden = true;
    kaizen_state.selected_id = null;
  });

  function kaizen_download(content, type, filename) {
    const blob = new Blob([content], {type});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.append(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function kaizen_export_records() {
    const export_timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    return kaizen_state.experiments.map((experiment) => ({
      export_timestamp,
      ...experiment,
      action_steps: experiment.action_steps.map((step) => ({...step}))
    }));
  }

  function kaizen_can_export() {
    if (kaizen_state.experiments.length > 0) return true;
    kaizen_notify("Import gaps or add an experiment before exporting.");
    return false;
  }

  kaizen_json.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!kaizen_can_export()) return;
    kaizen_download(
      JSON.stringify(kaizen_export_records(), null, 2),
      "application/json;charset=utf-8",
      "kaizen-experiments.json"
    );
    kaizen_notify(
      "Kaizen roadmap ready. Save or move kaizen-experiments.json into output/."
    );
  });

  function kaizen_csv_value(value) {
    return `"${String(value ?? "").replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
  }

  kaizen_csv.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!kaizen_can_export()) return;
    const columns = [
      "export_timestamp",
      "id",
      "pipeline_family",
      "title",
      "target_gap",
      "hypothesis",
      "action_steps",
      "owner",
      "success_metric",
      "priority",
      "pdca_stage",
      "status",
      "source_gap_status"
    ];
    const records = kaizen_export_records().map((record) => ({
      ...record,
      action_steps: record.action_steps
        .map((step) => `${step.done ? "[x]" : "[ ]"} ${step.text}`)
        .join("; ")
    }));
    const lines = [
      columns.map(kaizen_csv_value).join(","),
      ...records.map((record) =>
        columns.map((column) => kaizen_csv_value(record[column])).join(",")
      )
    ];
    kaizen_download(
      lines.join("\r\n"),
      "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
      "kaizen-experiments.csv"
    );
    kaizen_notify(
      "Kaizen roadmap ready. Save or move kaizen-experiments.csv into output/."
    );
  });

  Object.defineProperty(kaizen_root, "value", {
    get: () => ({experiments: structuredClone(kaizen_state.experiments)})
  });

  kaizen_render();
  return kaizen_root;
}
```
